course.title: Linear Algebra, Complex Variable and Vector Analysis

content.value: Define rank of a matrix. Compute the rank of the matrix $A = { \left[ \begin{array} { l l l l } { 1 } & { 2 } & { 1 } & { - 1 } \\ { 9 } & { 5 } & { 2 } & { 2 } \\ { 7 } & { 1 } & { 0 } & { 4 } \end{array} \right] }$
using minors. Also find the reduced row echelon form of A and verify your answer.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
